summary: Tested the 3 new features (CSV Import, Reconciliation, Receipt Attachments) + regression. Backend: 10/10 new pytest tests + 24/24 existing regression tests pass (34/34). Frontend Playwright validated: Import dialog opens, template download returns 200, CSV upload with 2 valid + 2 invalid rows shows 'import-result' with '2 transactions imported', '1 payee(s), 2 category(ies), 1 fund(s)' auto-created, and 2 skipped rows listed with reasons (Invalid Date, Invalid Type). Imported txns appear in list. Reconcile bar appears after selecting *3217 in filter-account, shows cleared/current/uncleared values. Ticking cleared-<id> drops cleared_balance by txn amount (76,880.68 -> 76,838.18 for a $42.50 expense); unticking reverts. New expense with PNG attachment saves successfully, paperclip icon appears on the row, re-opening lists the attachment with view/delete buttons; delete removes it from the list (confirmed in run 2). view-attachment hit a one-time 502 from Emergent object storage proxy but 5 subsequent back-to-back downloads returned 200 — classified as transient third-party flake. All CRUD + regression unaffected.

integration_issues.issue: api.get for /attachments/{id}/download has no try/catch; a transient 502 from object storage surfaces as an unhandled promise rejection (Emergent error overlay) instead of a toast.error. Low priority — only reproduced once in ~10 attempts.

action_items: Optional (minor UX): wrap viewExisting and deleteExisting in try/catch in /app/frontend/src/components/TransactionDialog.js so a transient 502 from object storage shows a toast instead of the Emergent 'A background operation failed' overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: CSV import correctly auto-creates distinct income/expense categories keyed by (name,type) — avoids collisions.
import_transactions reads entire CSV into memory and bulk-inserts; fine for small files but no size cap enforced (unlike attachments' 15MB cap). Consider adding a max rows/size guard.

Download endpoint accepts JWT via ?auth= query param (needed for src / window.open). Backend validates signature but not role; acceptable for authenticated users and small scope, but any valid non-expired token can download any file. Fine for single-tenant church app; flag if multi-tenant later.
server.py now 1131 lines — reiterating prior comment about splitting into modules (auth, transactions, imports, attachments, reports).
Transactions list adds attachment_count via per-page aggregation — efficient. Good.
TransactionDialog viewExisting/deleteExisting lack try/catch — propagates to window-level unhandled rejection (overlay).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (import, template, reconcile toggle, attachment upload/list/paperclip/delete) verified

seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up: TEST_UI_Payee, TEST_UI_IncCat, TEST_UI_ExpCat, TEST_UI_Fund, and TEST_IMP_* equivalents, plus test txns and attachments. Verified cleanup via browser-side DELETE calls at end of UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: data-testids used: btn-open-import, btn-download-template, import-file-input, btn-run-import, import-result, filter-account (option contains 'name *mask'), reconcile-bar, reconcile-cleared, cleared-<id>, attachment-input, attachment-<id>, btn-view-attachment-<id>, btn-delete-attachment-<id>, btn-save-transaction. For Select options in dialogs, add 400ms wait after opening and click [role='option'] with has_text. Backend /api/import/transactions is multipart. Download endpoint accepts both Bearer header and ?auth=<jwt> query. Object storage can intermittently 502 (Emergent proxy) — retry if needed.
rca of the issue: No defects. One transient 502 observed on GET /attachments/{id}/download during a view-attachment click; 5 consecutive retries returned 200 — attributed to Emergent object storage proxy flakiness, not an app bug. The only mitigation worth doing is adding a try/catch around viewExisting to avoid showing the Emergent unhandled-rejection overlay.
